title: Testing and QA
meta: A full test of your new store before you switch the domain, with a clear list of issues and fixes. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Test your new store before the domain switch
overview: Launching a store you have not tested is a gamble with your own customers. We go through the new store as a shopper would, adding products to the cart, applying discounts, paying with test cards, and checking emails, forms and mobile layout. We compare data against the old store and send a list of problems, ranked by importance, with fixes made for the quick ones.

list: Search titles and redirects spot check

faq: Do you test with real payments?
No. We use the payment provider's test mode and test cards, or a real order we refund at once if you ask. Your customers are never charged during testing, and we never use anyone else's card.
Do you need the old store as well?
For Standard and Premium, yes, view access to the old store lets us compare products and orders. For Basic we only check the new store, so the old store access is optional.
Will you tell me if the store is not ready?
Yes, plainly. The Premium report ends with a go or no-go view and the reasons. If something serious is wrong, we say so and show what must be fixed first.
Is this the same as a speed or SEO audit?
Only in part. We spot check speed and search titles so launch problems show up. Full audits are separate services and go into much more detail.
